steps.npc: Don't you try anything, surface-dweller. I'm keeping an eye on you.
Welcome, surface-dweller, to the hidden city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
I don't want to be unfriendly, but I can't help noticing that since surface-dwellers started coming into the city there has been an increase in CRIME!
Surface-dweller! I don't know how you got into the city, but you will never escape!

steps.player: But... I thought I was allowed into the city!

steps.npc: You are. I just wanted to say that. And now that you're allowed into the city, I'll never be able to!
